column1: # One row per protection that this project has already paid for once. Each row
# names a patch that REVERTS the protection, and the test that must then fail.
# A protection whose removal changes nothing is not a protection; it is a
# comment with an if statement around it.
#   patch-file  relative to tests/rediscovery/, applied with patch -p1 at the
#               repository root of a scratch copy
#   tier        which tier the named test belongs to (run.sh --tier selects)
#   stage       the tier-6/7 stage name, or '-' for tiers with no stages
#   test        the test file, relative to the repository root, that MUST fail
